ai_summary: Arvind SmartHomes Private Limited (ASHPL), a material subsidiary of Arvind SmartSpaces Limited (ASSL), secured an 'IND A/Stable' rating for its proposed INR 1,000 million Optional Convertible Debentures, largely due to strong operational and strategic linkages with its higher-rated parent. This financing will support ASHPL's new project development and contribute to ASSL's aggressive business expansion plans, which have led to a substantial increase in consolidated net debt. A key concern is the parent's projected debt repayment requirements potentially exceeding net operational cash flow in the medium term, raising questions about future liquidity management despite strong pre-sales.
